_comment: ChingMu human-skeleton sensor id -> GMR smplx body name. Keys are ChingMu VRPN integer sensor ids (from your ChingMu software's segment numbering); values MUST be one of the 14 names GMR's smplx src expects. Keys starting with '_' are ignored (docs). REPLACE the placeholder ids below (0-13) with YOUR ChingMu sensor ids, then run retarget_server_gmr.py --src-human smplx.
